snippet.title: LAUNCHING 13th NOVEMBER | Pre-Order RENNSPORT On Console!
snippet.description:
Coming to PC & Console—RENNSPORT officially launches on November 13th, 2025. Pre-Orders for PS5® and Xbox Series X|S are now available, full release details for PC to follow.

🔵 Pre-Order for PS5®: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP6665-PPSA28297_00-RS000DELUXE00001
🟢 Pre-Order for Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/rennsport-deluxe-edition/9PP9Q8XBVSXG/0017
🆚 Pre-Order for PC: Full Details coming soon.

Don't forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell for the latest RENNSPORT updates, gameplay, and news. 

📲 Follow Us: Instagram | X | Facebook | TikTok
